checkParams: Please check the parameters according to the tutorial.
title: MCP Servers
allowPermissionsDesc: When enabled, all MCP tool calls will be automatically approved without showing permission dialogs. This setting applies globally to all conversations, including new chats.

runtimeSettings.title: Runtime Settings
runtimeSettings.description: Configure how Rey30 IDvj manages and retries MCP servers.
runtimeSettings.toolCallTimeoutDesc: Maximum time to wait for an MCP tool response before timing out.
runtimeSettings.maxToolOutputCharsDesc: Longest tool result kept in the conversation. Anything past this is trimmed and marked as truncated, so one large result cannot exhaust the model's context. Set to 0 to keep results whole.
runtimeSettings.smartToolRoutingDesc: When enabled, Rey30 IDvj selects relevant MCP servers before loading tools. Disable to always load the full MCP tool list.
runtimeSettings.useLightweightRouterModel: Use a dedicated model for routing
runtimeSettings.useLightweightRouterModelDesc: When smart routing is on, run the routing step with a separate (often smaller) model instead of the chat model. Turn off to always use the active chat model for routing.
runtimeSettings.routerModelDesc: Choose provider and model in one place. Only lightweight models are listed so routing stays fast and cheap.
runtimeSettings.routerModelEmptyList: No lightweight models available. Add a smaller model or configure API keys in Models.

catalog.title: MCP catalog
catalog.description: Browse the official MCP Registry and review an exact version before installing.
catalog.searchHint: Enter at least three characters, or leave empty to browse registry.modelcontextprotocol.io.
catalog.cursorError: The registry repeated a page. Search again to refresh.
catalog.manualOnly: No automatically supported recipe. Review the warnings and configure this server manually in MCP settings.
catalog.installFailed: Installation failed. Review the reported requirements.
catalog.installed: Installed {{name}} inactive. Complete its connection below.
catalog.secretStorage: Values use the operating system keyring and the existing encrypted local fallback. MCP configuration stores only opaque references.
catalog.credentialsSaved: Values saved securely. You can now check the connection.
catalog.credentialsFailed: Values could not be saved. No values were written to MCP configuration.
catalog.providerConsent: The provider chooses Google, password, or another sign-in method. You authorize in its browser. Stdio servers use environment values, not MCP HTTP OAuth.
catalog.connectionFailed: The server did not confirm a connection.
catalog.missingServer: The installed server no longer exists. Refresh settings.
catalog.authorizationRequired: Authorization required. Sign in below, then check the connection again.
catalog.authorized: Authorization completed. Check the connection to load tools.
catalog.clearFailed: Stored authorization could not be cleared.
catalog.stopFailed: Disconnection could not be confirmed. Check the server state in MCP settings.
catalog.refreshFailed: Installed, but the list could not refresh. Close the catalog and refresh settings.
catalog.publicParameters: Public URL or argument parameters. Do not enter keys or passwords; complete the desired alternative and update the review.
